Parks & Playgrounds: Feedback or complaints specifically about parks programming, events, or facilities. | NOT: Overgrown grass or maintenance issues at parks (see Excessive Growth).

Sewer Problems (Sanitary Sewers): Odors, leaks, or other issues related to sanitary sewer systems, including private sewer pumps. | NOT: Water leaks not clearly tied to sewers (see Water Utility Problems).

Traffic Related Complaints: Complaints about driver behavior, such as running red lights. | NOT: Physical obstructions or signage issues (see Blocked Street, Temporary Signage w/o permit).

Trash: General trash issues, including missed pick-up, exceeding can/weight limits, and missed recycling pick-up (counterintuitively, missed recycling pick-up is filed here if not specifically about recycling sorting). | NOT: Recycling sorting/mixing issues (see Recycling), yard waste (see Yard Waste).

Unsafe Buildings: Reports of abandoned, vacant, or dangerous buildings, including structural concerns. | NOT: Overgrown lots or yards (see Excessive Growth).

Water Quality: Issues with water quality, such as trouble with water heaters or leaks at meters. | NOT: Water utility billing or service problems (see Water Utility Billing Problems, Water Utility Problems).

Water Utility Billing Problems: Requests or complaints about water billing, credits, or account adjustments. | NOT: Water leaks or service interruptions (see Water Utility Problems).

Water Utility Problems: Water leaks, service interruptions, or requests for water shut-off, including water bubbling up from the street. | NOT: Water quality issues (see Water Quality), billing issues (see Water Utility Billing Problems).

Yard Waste: Issues with yard waste pick-up, including weight/can limits and missing stickers. | NOT: General trash or recycling issues (see Trash, Recycling).
